numeric_templates.person_first: {name} began {initial} to the left of the {object}. {name} moved {person_move} right, and the {object} moved {object_move} right.
numeric_templates.object_first: The {object} began {initial} to the right of {name}. The {object} moved {object_move} right, and {name} moved {person_move} right.

person_first.closer: {name} began to the left of the {object}. Both moved right, but {name} covered more ground without reaching the {object}.
person_first.farther: {name} began to the left of the {object}. Both moved right, but the {object} covered more ground than {name}.
person_first.unchanged: {name} began to the left of the {object}. Both moved right by equal distances.

object_first.closer: The {object} began to the right of {name}. Both moved right, but {name} covered more ground without reaching the {object}.
object_first.farther: The {object} began to the right of {name}. Both moved right, but the {object} covered more ground than {name}.
object_first.unchanged: The {object} began to the right of {name}. Both moved right by equal distances.
